import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 11;
    static final int MAX_VERTICES = 1000;
    static final int MAX_ARCS = 100100;
    static final int BIG_NUMBER = (1 << 29);

    static class Arrow {
        int to;
        int f;
        int c;
        int nxt;

        Arrow(int to, int f, int c, int nxt) {
            this.to = to;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.nxt = nxt;
        }
    }

    static Arrow[] arcs = new Arrow[2 * MAX_ARCS];
    static int[] adj_list = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static int[] adj_iter = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static int[] depth = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static int[] dq_buf = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    static int total_arcs, vertex_count, src, dst, dq_tail, dq_head;

    static void net_init(int V, int s, int d) {
        vertex_count = V;
        src = s;
        dst = d;
        total_arcs = 2;
        Arrays.fill(adj_list, 0, V + 1, 0);
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        arcs[total_arcs] = new Arrow(v, 0, cap, adj_list[u]);
        adj_list[u] = total_arcs++;
        arcs[total_arcs] = new Arrow(u, 0, 0, adj_list[v]);
        adj_list[v] = total_arcs++;
    }

    static boolean make_level() {
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0, vertex_count + 1, 0);
        dq_tail = dq_head = 0;
        dq_buf[dq_tail++] = src;
        depth[src] = 1;
        while (dq_head < dq_tail && depth[dst] == 0) {
            int u = dq_buf[dq_head++];
            for (int e = adj_list[u]; e != 0; e = arcs[e].nxt) {
                int v = arcs[e].to;
                if (depth[v] == 0 && arcs[e].f < arcs[e].c) {
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    dq_buf[dq_tail++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return depth[dst] != 0;
    }

    static int push(int u, int cap) {
        if (u == dst) return cap;
        for (int e = adj_iter[u]; e != 0; e = adj_iter[u] = arcs[e].nxt) {
            int v = arcs[e].to;
            if (depth[u] < depth[v] && arcs[e].f < arcs[e].c) {
                int pushed = push(v, Math.min(cap, arcs[e].c - arcs[e].f));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    arcs[e].f += pushed;
                    arcs[e ^ 1].f -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int flow() {
        int ans = 0, del;
        while (make_level()) {
            System.arraycopy(adj_list, 0, adj_iter, 0, vertex_count + 1);
            while ((del = push(src, BIG_NUMBER)) > 0) {
                ans += del;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int N;
    static String[] map1 = new String[MAX_SIZE];
    static String[] map2 = new String[MAX_SIZE];

    static int[] di = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] dj = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean ok(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < N && j < N && !map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Y") && !map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Z");
    }

    static int[][][] dists = new int[2][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

    static void spread(int si, int sj, int which) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_SIZE; j++) {
                dists[which][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dists[which][si][sj] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{si, sj});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int i = cell[0], j = cell[1];
            if (which == 1 && dists[0][i][j] != 0 && dists[0][i][j] <= dists[1][i][j]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int ni = i + di[k], nj = j + dj[k];
                if (ok(ni, nj) && dists[which][ni][nj] == 0) {
                    dists[which][ni][nj] = dists[which][i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] vert = new int[2][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int Tmax = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int zr = 0, zc = 0;
        int cnt = 0, s = 0, t = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            map1[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Z")) {
                    zr = i;
                    zc = j;
                } else if (!map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Y")) {
                    cnt++;
                    vert[0][i][j] = cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            map2[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (!map2[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Y") && !map2[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Z")) {
                    cnt++;
                    vert[1][i][j] = cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        cnt++;
        s = 0;
        t = cnt;
        net_init(cnt, s, t);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (!map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Z") && !map1[i].substring(j, j + 1).equals("Y")) {
                    connect(s, vert[0][i][j], map1[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    connect(vert[1][i][j], t, map2[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        spread(zr, zc, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char c = map1[i].charAt(j);
                if (c > '0' && c <= '9') {
                    spread(i, j, 1);
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < N; ++ii) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < N; ++jj) {
                            char cc = map2[ii].charAt(jj);
                            if (cc > '0' && cc <= '9') {
                                if (dists[1][ii][jj] != 0 && (dists[0][ii][jj] == 0 || dists[0][ii][jj] >= dists[1][ii][jj]) && dists[1][ii][jj] - 1 <= Tmax) {
                                    connect(vert[0][i][j], vert[1][ii][jj], BIG_NUMBER);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow());
    }
}
